value.name: Micky walks away silently
value.description: Micky walks away in silence, suggesting an emotionally heavy transition out of the moment.
evidence: Then let's him go into distance.

value.name: Days later training montage begins
value.description: The scene shifts to days later, showing Micky back in training at Ramalho's gym.
evidence: DISSOLVE TO: OMITTED RAMALHO'S WEST END GYM - DAYS

value.name: Micky trains intensely
value.description: Micky jumps rope, works his abs, hits the speed bag, and moves in the ring as part of a hard training session.
evidence: MICKY JUMPS ROPE; MICKY DOES ABS WORK under Mickey O'Keefe's watchful gaze.; MICKY HITS SPEED BAG; MICKY MOVES IN RING. JUMPS ROPE AGAIN.

value.name: Charlene and George are revealed at the gym
value.description: The camera reveals Charlene, George, and Sal LoNano watching Micky train.
evidence: Pan reveals: Charlene, George, and SAL LONANO, 45, Italian, dark, mustache, tinted glasses, thick dark hair, watch.

value.name: Micky greets Charlene
value.description: Micky stops training, catches his breath, and kisses Charlene hello.
evidence: Micky stops jumping, catching his breath. Kisses Charlene hello.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe praises Micky's persistence
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe tells Sal and the others that Micky keeps trying, is protected by fate, and is not finished as a fighter.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE Nobody keeps tryin' like this kid, I swear to God someone up there's watchin' over him, he's far from done. He'll take five punches to land one, that's how he fights, that's who he is.

value.name: Micky meets Sal LoNano
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe introduces Sal LoNano to Micky, and Micky shakes his hand.

value.name: Micky questions Sal's business
value.description: Micky sizes up Sal by asking whether he is a good businessman because he owns a cab company.
evidence: MICKY You own a cab company, you're a good businessman, right?

value.name: Sal offers a local comeback fight
value.description: Sal says he has already made calls and can arrange a small local fight to help Micky restart his career.
evidence: SAL LONANO (NODS) I already made some calls. Spoke to Bobby Tags and he says we can get a small fight, somethin' local to staht back with.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe frames the fight as a confidence boost
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe explains that the local fight is meant to help Micky regain confidence.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE Get ya confidence back.
SAL LONANO Right, go from there.

value.name: Mickey O'Keefe sets conditions for training Micky
value.description: Mickey O'Keefe agrees to train Micky only if Dicky and Alice stay away, making clear he will quit if they return.
evidence: MICKEY O'KEEFE - Micky, I know ya dad wants this guy to manage ya, and I'll train ya on one condition.
MICKEY O'KEEFE No Dicky, no Alice. If they come back, I'm gone, Mick. I can't deal with the bullshit, no offense Georgie.

value.name: Charlene rejects chaos
value.description: Charlene backs the condition by insisting there will be no more crazy behavior.
